reconfigure.title: Change ClearOne connection
reconfigure.description: Use this when the ClearOne's IP address or login changed. Leave the password empty to keep the current one. The connection is checked before saving; volume caps, scenes and options are kept.

init.title: Options
init.description: Arylic media player: room speakers stream through it. Power switch: the relay of the ClearOne and the amplifier (adds an on/off button to the panel and enables automatic power). Automatic power: switch on when the Arylic starts playing or a room speaker is used, and switch off after the set minutes without sound. Sound counts when a source's input level is above the threshold, from sources switched on in an unmuted room; ignored sources (e.g. Birds playing all day) never count. See the live input levels on the panel's Inputs tab to choose the threshold.

data.auto_on: Switch on automatically when the Arylic plays or a room speaker is used
data.hold_playback: Pause the Arylic until the ClearOne is ready (keeps the start of the music)
data.auto_off: Switch off automatically when there is no sound
data.idle_minutes: Minutes without sound before switching off
data.ignored_sources: Ignore these sources for switching off
